terminals.name: bot
terminals.command: bash .cursor/start.sh; if [ -n "$DISCORD_TOKEN" ]; then npm start; else echo 'DISCORD_TOKEN not set. Add DISCORD_TOKEN + CLIENT_ID as secrets (or in .env) and run: npm start'; fi
terminals.description: Ensures PostgreSQL is up (via .cursor/start.sh), then runs the TitanBot process (npm start). Requires DISCORD_TOKEN + CLIENT_ID to connect to Discord; serves the health API on port 3000.
